samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Cảm ơn
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

I am writing to thank you for helping me prepare for a neighbourhood walking event. It was kind of you to give up part of your weekend, and I really appreciate the time you spent checking the plan with me.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu hành động được giúp và sự trân trọng.

paragraphs.label: Tác dụng
paragraphs.text: Your suggestions helped us explore a short local route and note useful improvements without rushing through the instructions. You also reminded me to prepare comfortable walking shoes. That small detail made the session easier to organise, and I felt much more confident when the other participants arrived.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dùng chi tiết để lời cảm ơn cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Điều học được
paragraphs.text: The discussion was useful because people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. One example that stayed with me was this: a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. I would not have had as much time to listen and learn if I had still been struggling with the preparations on my own.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Đáp lại
paragraphs.text:
I would like to take you out for lunch next weekend as a small way of saying thank you. Please tell me which day would suit you. Thanks again for being so supportive.

Best wishes,
Minh
